summary: Build a native deterministic Category 2 Test Lab for targeted diagnosis with persistent isolated runs, normalized session evidence, multi-profile execution, scoring/sweeps, Control Center/CLI access, and no embedded intelligence.
locked_constraints: Test Lab is a native Jarvis subsystem, not a pytest family.
Persistent isolated TestRuns with supervised workers.
One diagnostic identity can have specialized profiles.
Catalog plus safe ad-hoc scenarios; no arbitrary code execution.
Run-local overrides/sweeps never mutate permanent settings.
DiagnosticBundle is first-class for real sessions.
Manifest plus specialized implementation is the official diagnostic format.
planning_blockers: Workspace Task Type vocabulary is not exposed; Slice 00 must assign valid existing Task Types before implementation dispatch.
